Hi Sophie —

No problem at all, and thanks for the note. This is a pretty common calendar edge-case: the original invite had the timezone set to UTC, and some calendar clients will show that as a local-time translation but other clients (or browser views) will display the raw UTC slot. We've updated the invite so the timezone field is explicit (Europe/Amsterdam / CET) — attaching a corrected .ics that should import cleanly.

Proposed new slots (all in CET / Europe/Amsterdam):
- Wed 9 Dec, 14:00–14:30 CET
- Thu 10 Dec, 15:00–15:30 CET
- Fri 11 Dec, 13:30–14:00 CET

Aditya (SE) will join to run the live latency/cost section — Aditya, are you available for Wed 14:00 or Thu 15:00?

If any of those work for you, accept the attached invite-cet-corrected.ics or tell me a preferred slot and I'll send a new calendar event with the explicit timezone set.

Quick note: HubSpot record for the deal is here if you want to add any internal notes: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1043

Thanks — speak soon,
